passage.text: Hi, Nam! How are you doing with money this month?
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ˈhaʊ ər juː ˈduːɪŋ wɪð ˈmʌni ˈðɪs ˈmʌnθ?

passage.text: Your dad and I want to help if you need it.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈdæd ənd aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈhɛlp ɪf juː ˈniːd ɪt.

passage.text: Hi, Mom! I'm OK, but this month was expensive.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈmɑːm! aɪm oʊˈkeɪ, bʌt ˈðɪs ˈmʌnθ wʌz ɪkˈspɛnsɪv.

passage.text: Rent is 4,500 baht, and utilities are about 800 baht.
passage.reading: ˈrɛnt ɪz ˈfɔːr ˈθaʊzənd ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt, ənd juːˈtɪlətiz ər əˈbaʊt ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: I spend about 3,500 baht on groceries and food.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈspɛnd əˈbaʊt ˈθriː ˈθaʊzənd ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt ɑːn ˈɡroʊsəriz ənd ˈfuːd.

passage.text: My phone and my music subscription are 500 baht.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈfoʊn ənd maɪ ˈmjuːzɪk səbˈskrɪpʃən ər ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: Entertainment is the problem. I went to the movies four times this month!
passage.reading: ˌɛntərˈteɪnmənt ɪz ðə ˈprɑːbləm. aɪ ˈwɛnt tə ðə ˈmuːviz ˈfɔːr ˈtaɪmz ˈðɪs ˈmʌnθ!

passage.text: Four times? That's a lot of entertainment!
passage.reading: ˈfɔːr ˈtaɪmz? ðæts ə ˈlɑːt əv ˌɛntərˈteɪnmənt!

passage.text: Try to make a budget and keep your entertainment spending under 1,000 baht.
passage.reading: ˈtraɪ tə ˈmeɪk ə ˈbʌdʒɪt ənd ˈkiːp jʊr ˌɛntərˈteɪnmənt ˈspɛndɪŋ ˈʌndər ˈwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: I'll send you 2,000 baht for groceries this time.
passage.reading: aɪl ˈsɛnd juː ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt fər ˈɡroʊsəriz ˈðɪs ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: Thank you, Mom! You're the best.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈmɑːm! jʊr ðə ˈbɛst.

passage.text: I'll cancel my music subscription, too.
passage.reading: aɪl ˈkænsəl maɪ ˈmjuːzɪk səbˈskrɪpʃən, ˈtuː.

passage.text: Next month, I'll cook more and spend less.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ, aɪl ˈkʊk ˈmɔːr ənd ˈspɛnd ˈlɛs.
